name: agent-avatar
description: Aggregates Codex session, tool and subagent events into a semantic state for the Agent Avatar desktop companion to read. A pure observer: it changes nothing about Codex and takes no part in permission decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Let a desktop mascot follow your Codex session
interface.longDescription: Watches Codex's lifecycle events (prompting, running tools, delegating to subagents, wrapping up) and aggregates them into one mutually exclusive semantic state written to a local state file, which the Agent Avatar desktop mascot uses to switch expressions and motions. Read-only: it never returns an instruction, never blocks a tool and never takes part in approvals.
defaultPrompt: Make the desktop mascot follow what this task is doing
